items.title: Transformation eines typisierten Baumgraphen
items.display:
\begin{aligned}[t]
    &f\colon A\to X\dsep g\colon X\times X\to X\dsep
      D\in\powerset(\BracketTreeSet{A})\dsep G\colon D\to X
      \vdash{}\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(i)}\;D\in\powerset(\NonemptyWords{\TreeAlphabet{A}})\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(ii)}\;G\in\powerset(\BracketTreeSet{A}\times X)\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(iii)}\;\mathcal R_{f,g}(G)
      \subseteq\TreeClosure{A}{D}\times X\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(iv)}\;\forall a\in A\,\forall z\,
      \bigl((\LeafTree{A}{a},z)\in\mathcal R_{f,g}(G)
        \leftrightarrow z=f(a)\bigr)\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(v)}\;\forall S,T\in D\,\forall z\,
      \bigl((\NodeTree{A}{S}{T},z)\in\mathcal R_{f,g}(G)
        \leftrightarrow z=g(G(S),G(T))\bigr)\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(vi)}\;\mathcal R_{f,g}(G)\colon\TreeClosure{A}{D}\to X\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(vii)}\;\forall a\in A\,
      \mathcal R_{f,g}(G)(\LeafTree{A}{a})=f(a)\\[-2pt]
    &\text{(viii)}\;\forall S,T\in D\,
      \mathcal R_{f,g}(G)(\NodeTree{A}{S}{T})
        =g(G(S),G(T))
  \end{aligned}
